paragraphs: Ami bar Shmuel, Niddah 26b. Chanina bar Shmuel, [Yerushalmi Sukkah 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sukkah.1.1.6).
Rav Yehuda bar Shmuel, [Shabbat 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.38a.6). Levi bar Shmuel, [Shabbat 47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.47a.6).

Rav Papa bar Shmuel, [Shabbat 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.54b.12). Rava bar Shmuel, [Berakhot 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22b.11). Rabbah bar Shmuel, Berakhot 28a. Ravin bar Shmuel, [Bava Batra 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.43a.4). Rami bar Shmuel, Ketubot 96a.

notes.text: This is a collective index of sages with the patronymic bar Shmuel, not a claim that they shared one father.

The consulted Yerushalmi reads Rabbi Chanina son of Shmuel, and Berakhot 22b gives Rava bar Rabbi bar Shmuel. Ravin in Bava Batra transmits in Shmuel’s name. These are individual notices within a collective list.
